payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate t from 1 to 100, compute total adjustment cost for sticks to be almost good for t (abs cost = max(0, |a_i - t| - 1)), track minimum.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all plausible t values, which is exhaustive search. Among given complete_search subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is the closest, though the code is iterative not recursive.
